title: Testing: unit tests, Compose UI tests and screenshot tests

videos.script: A test is defined by where it runs, and the place decides what it costs. {{layers}} Three places. Your computer's JVM with no Android at all. The same JVM with a stand-in Android. And a real phone. The first takes milliseconds, the second seconds, the third a device. {{unit}} First a unit test, and a mistake it catches. A week that starts on Sunday, and three failures that each say exactly how. {{compose}} Then a Compose test. Find the total, tick a box, read the total again. It never looks inside the screen. And the rule this course has used is deprecated now, so you will see the warning and the one-line fix. {{shots}} Then a screenshot test. Record a picture, change one padding, and watch the comparison light up in red. {{device}} Then an instrumented test, and the honest answer from a machine with no phone: no connected devices. {{what}} And last, what to test at all: the failures nobody would notice.
